summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but untested: I did not run anything, per the instructions. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI; Console.print_json placed after print in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; a "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst; a new docs/source/reference/json.rst added to the reference toctree; a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased; and new tests in tests/test_json.py. Interpretation choices: "overflow to none" is set to Python None; the number fraction requires digits after the dot; hex is matched before decimal. Caveats: the expected ANSI strings in test_print_json_styled_output were derived by hand from rich's style rendering rules and may need adjustment. I also used an inline Python heredoc for two text insertions (toctree and changelog). Next step: run pytest on tests/test_json.py and tests/test_rich_print.py, then the full suite.
